_about: Synthetic eval set for `audit.py calibrate`. Every fact is invented for a synthetic memory-audit-probe-* actor. A retrieved record counts as a correct match for a fact when its text contains any of the fact's `keys` at the start of a word, case-insensitive (chosen to survive the extraction model's paraphrasing). `shape` says how the fact is stated; `sessions` groups the user turns into conversations, in order. `related` names facts on the same topic: their records are on-topic for this fact's questions, so they count as neither a match nor noise; so does any record containing one of `relatedKeys` (side facts extracted from the same message, such as field notes).

fillers.pasted: Here are my notes from lecture so the context is clear. Plate boundaries come in three kinds: divergent, where plates move apart and new crust forms at mid-ocean ridges; convergent, where one plate subducts beneath another and builds volcanic arcs or mountain belts; and transform, where plates slide past each other along faults such as the one that runs through coastal California. Earthquake depth increases with distance from the trench along a subduction zone, tracing the descending slab.
